description: This is a unit test class for the FeaturePropertyDeleted class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.things package. It contains tests to verify immutability, equals and hashCode methods, object creation with various parameters, JSON serialization/deserialization, and the handling of null inputs.

classes.name: FeaturePropertyDeletedTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the FeaturePropertyDeleted class functionalities.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that instances of FeaturePropertyDeleted are immutable and that JsonPointer and JsonValue are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies equals and hashCode implementations for FeaturePropertyDeleted using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating an instance with a null ThingId string throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Ensures that creating an instance with a null ThingId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Ensures that creating an instance with a null feature ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPropertyJsonPointer
methods.description: Ensures that creating an instance with a null property JsonPointer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson() method returns the expected JSON representation of the object.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests deserialization of FeaturePropertyDeleted from JSON and verifies fields are correctly populated.
